facts.business: MT Educare Limited provides coaching services through a network of centres across Maharashtra, supplemented by digital content delivery via an in-house platform.

auditor.name: M/s. MGB & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of opinion due to inability to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence; matters include unresolved CIRP claims, unverified asset/liability carrying amounts, non-compliance with Ind AS 109, 36, 37, and improper recognition of deferred tax assets on loans under Ind AS 12.

key_risks: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) ongoing since December 2022
Significant faculty attrition and disruption in centre operations
Liquidity constraints leading to delayed remuneration and vendor payments
Inability to refresh digital content and enhance platform
Uncertainty over final claims by creditors, employees, and statutory authorities
Non-recognition of interest expense on borrowings
Barred from Ministry of Minority Affairs schemes for 5 years with grant recovery and penal interest
Employee fraud instances identified (Rs. 50 lakhs and Rs. 123 lakhs misappropriation)
Going concern uncertainty due to unresolved CIRP and financial stress
